detail.longDescription: I got into homelabbing a year ago and have been deploying OSS and making some of my own to address some pain points in my everyday life. One particular area I thought I could improve was keeping in touch with people. Well that first required having a centralized place to see all my contacts. I have some friends on my Google contacts, other relationships on LinkedIn and even some in Facebook. A secondary need is something that's been blowing up recently with people search. LLMs + Search are surprisingly good at aggregating relevant data and parsing through for relevant information. And finally a last need is to keep me disciplined and remind me to reach out to people when it's been a while. And thus I made Contrack! Aggregate your contacts, smart dedupe, and enrich with people search to get a local repo of your contacts with up-to-date info. Track your contacts as well to remind yourself to keep in touch :)
